verdict.rationale: Xero clearly supports invoice creation with customizable templates and online payment acceptance via Stripe (credit/debit cards, digital wallets, ACH, Klarna), plus an AI-assisted invoicing tool (JAX) for creating/sending invoices. However, no direct evidence confirms invoice view/read tracking or explicit paid-status notification tied to online payment completion. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on confirmation of 'invoice viewed' tracking, independent corroboration of the payment-status visibility workflow, and detail on how paid status syncs in real time from Stripe payments.
